column4: The project owner's ruling of 2026-11-02: two Achsahs. 'And the daughter of Caleb was Achsa' (1 Chronicles 2:49) closes the line of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2:9, 18, 42); the Achsah of Joshua 15:16-17 and Judges 1:12-13 is the daughter of Caleb son of Jephunneh. Whether the two Calebs are one man the text does not say.

column4: 1 Chronicles 6 writes 'Amariah begat Ahitub, and Ahitub begat Zadok' twice, at 6:7-8 and at 6:11-12, six generations apart. The first Ahitub is the grandfather of David's Zadok's son Ahimaaz; the second is Ezra's ancestor (Ezra 7:2). Reading the second as the first written again is a conjecture about the text, not what it says.
